title: Slow Sundays at Fergusons: Yoga + Coffee
description: A cozy fall morning of gentle yoga, yin + coffee at Fergusons Downtown. Come move a little, stay awhile.
long_description:
A cozy fall morning of gentle yoga, yin + coffee at Fergusons Downtown. Come move a little, stay awhile.

About this Event

Slow Sundays is popping up at Fergusons Downtown. 🍂
Come spend a slow fall Sunday morning with us with 60 minutes of gentle yoga + yin, followed by a vanilla latte from Mothership Coffee included with your ticket.
We’ll move, stretch, breathe, and settle in with a beginner friendly flow designed to feel good in your body. Then we’ll wrap up, grab our coffees, and hang out for a bit at Fergusons.
No yoga experience needed. No need to be flexible. Just bring a mat, wear something comfy, and come spend the morning with us.
YOUR TICKET INCLUDES ✦
✦ 60-minute Slow Sundays yoga flow
✦ 1 vanilla latte from Mothership Coffee
✦ A cozy fall morning at Fergusons Downtown
SUNDAY, OCTOBER 25
10:00 AM
Fergusons Downtown
1028 E Fremont St., Las Vegas
WHAT TO BRING
Your yoga mat + water. Layers are a good idea since we'll be enjoying that late-October Vegas morning outside.
Come get cozy, move a little, drink some coffee, and stay awhile. 🤎
Spots are limited.

Also check out other in Las Vegas, Health & Wellness events in Las Vegas.
